# Ready-to-run Windows demos

Each folder contains an executable and the matching `harbour_ratatui.dll`.
Keep the two files together when launching the demo.

- `showcase/showcase.exe` — interactive RGB/menus/tree/table demo;
- `zig64/demo_zig64.exe` — Harbour + Zig64;
- `mingw64/demo_mingw64.exe` — Harbour + MinGW-w64;
- `mingw32/demo_mingw32.exe` — Harbour + MinGW 32-bit.
